sys_cb_topic.description: This is the main hotel guest concierge conversation. Use this topic when a hotel guest wants help with anything related to their hotel stay, including hotel information, hotel services, requests, complaints, room issues, amenities, facilities, restaurants, Wi-Fi, housekeeping, maintenance, transportation, or contacting hotel staff. When started, this topic asks the guest what they need help with and guides them through the appropriate hotel assistance option.

sys_cb_topic.title: Hotel Guest Concierge
